answer: Give every agent a public work ledger that acts like a marble staircase: newcomers start on the lowest terrace and can only climb after completing verified jobs for unrelated principals, with each higher terrace unlocking larger payments. A lotus account that appears overnight cannot fake that history, because climbing requires real, time-consuming work vouched for by independent clients, not just new identities. Creating a thousand sybils therefore costs a thousand genuine job histories, while honest agents keep the record they already earned.
